plan.background: Target 2 addresses the "Stabilization" requirement for the core Google My Business integration. Issues include transient network errors, token cache staleness on revocation (401 Hazard), and lack of automated test coverage for failure modes.

phase.name: Phase 2.1: TDD & Test Setup
phase.step: Create tests/services/test_google_api_service.py with TDD cases for retries and cache invalidation.
Mock Google API using responses library to simulate 502, 503, 401, and success paths.

phase.name: Phase 2.2: Hardening & Logic Implementation
phase.step: Implement a lightweight retry decorator in app/utils/decorators.py or directly in the service.
Implement cache invalidation logic in get_master_access_token().
Update fetch and reply functions to use retries and handle session expiry gracefully.

phase.name: Phase 2.3: Health Monitoring & Clean-Up
phase.step: Incorporate detailed log_event metrics for all failure scenarios to aid in admin debugging.
Refine return schema consistency across the service functions.
Perform final audit for security leaks (secrets in logs).

plan.verification: - Standard unit test run: pytest tests/services/test_google_api_service.py - Compile check: python -m py_compile all modified files.
